I answered Marcus in his DM: send the truck to Dock 27.

That comes from what Marcus told me in this DM on Oct 14: from then on, Dock 27 is the dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Driftwood project. I found it in the workspace's saved notes (gbrain), which only show that DM to him. The DM history in the Slack tools only goes back to today's message, so I couldn't double-check it there.

I found nothing newer in #north-team, the team channel he belongs to, that changes the dock. I told him the answer applies to Driftwood pickups and offered to check again if Thursday's pickup is for something else. I didn't share this anywhere outside his DM.
